regions.name: Jezero Crater
regions.description: Ancient river delta and lake bed. Perseverance rover landing site. Rich in clay minerals indicating past water activity. Strong astrobiological interest.

regions.name: Arcadia Planitia
regions.description: Smooth lowland plains in northern hemisphere. Candidate SpaceX Starship landing site. Subsurface water ice detected by radar. Relatively flat terrain suitable for landing.

regions.name: Hellas Planitia
regions.description: Deepest and largest visible impact basin on Mars. Highest surface atmospheric pressure on Mars (~1155 Pa). Potential for liquid water stability due to pressure. Challenging terrain at basin edges.

criteria_definitions.water_ice_evidence: Strength of evidence for accessible water ice (surface or shallow subsurface)
criteria_definitions.radiation_shielding: Natural protection from cosmic/solar radiation (terrain, atmosphere, depth)
criteria_definitions.terrain_accessibility: Ease of landing and surface traverse (flatness, rock density, slopes)
criteria_definitions.scientific_interest: Value for scientific research (geology, astrobiology, history)
criteria_definitions.resource_availability: Potential for in-situ resource utilisation (water, regolith, minerals)
criteria_definitions.atmospheric_conditions: Atmospheric pressure, dust storm frequency, temperature range

_notes: Evaluation criteria scores are no longer hardcoded here. They are dynamically calculated using ChromaDB vector search query match strength.
